evidence.competitive_awareness: All six technologies are squarely within the Conversational AI/LLM/Knowledge Graph domain — graph accelerators, transformer optimization, knowledge graph automation, and data lineage are all core to the stated domain — demonstrating solid domain coherence and awareness of key capability gaps in multi-agent AI systems.
evidence.market_timing: The mean timing error of 2.29 years is severe; five of six technologies complete significantly after their market boom windows (errors of 1.75–3.5 years), which is problematic even under 기술선도 strategy where completing 1-2 years before boom is ideal — here completions are systematically late rather than early, inverting the preemption logic.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (graph AI acceleration, transformer optimization, knowledge graph security) are plausible convergence zones for the domain, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting; the selection appears domain-driven rather than signal-driven from patent-market intersection analysis.
